record.original_question: Do all Artinian Gorenstein algebras of codimension three have the weak Lefschetz property, or even the strong Lefschetz property? If not, can one characterize which codimension-three Artinian Gorenstein algebras do have these properties?

evidence.quote: Question 2.6. Do all Artinian codimension three Gorenstein algebras have the WLP (or even the SLP)? If not, can one characterize those which do?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic zero, and let $A = \bigoplus_{i=0}^{d} A_i$ be a standard graded Artinian Gorenstein $k$-algebra of codimension three (so $A = k[x_1,x_2,x_3]/I$ for some homogeneous ideal $I$, with $\dim_k A_d = 1$ and the pairing $A_i \times A_{d-i} \to A_d$ being perfect). One says that $A$ has the Weak Lefschetz Property (WLP) if there exists a linear form $\ell \in A_1$ such that, for every $i$, the multiplication map $\times \ell : A_i \to A_{i+1}$ has maximal rank. One says that $A$ has the Strong Lefschetz Property (SLP) if there exists $\ell \in A_1$ such that for all $i$ and all $j \geq 0$ the map $\times \ell^{j} : A_i \to A_{i+j}$ has maximal rank.

(a) Does every standard graded Artinian Gorenstein $k$-algebra of codimension three have the WLP? Does it have the SLP?

(b) If the answer to (a) is negative, give an intrinsic characterization of those standard graded codimension-three Artinian Gorenstein $k$-algebras that have the WLP (respectively the SLP).
artifact.category_tag: Lefschetz properties of Artinian Gorenstein algebras
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a well-known long-standing open problem in commutative algebra. Partial results are known: in characteristic zero, all codimension-three complete intersections have the WLP (Harima–Migliore–Nagel–Watanabe), and recent work has established the WLP (and in some cases SLP) for codimension-three Artinian Gorenstein algebras with small Sperner number (maximum Hilbert function value at most six), and reduced the general problem to compressed Gorenstein algebras of odd socle degree. As of 2024–2025, the general WLP/SLP conjecture for codimension-three Artinian Gorenstein algebras remains open.

status_evidence.title: The weak Lefschetz property for artinian Gorenstein algebras of small Sperner number
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes WLP for codimension-three AG algebras whose Hilbert function has maximum value at most six, leaving the general case open.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial result; the general WLP conjecture in codimension three is still open.

status_evidence.title: The weak Lefschetz property for artinian Gorenstein algebras (Miró-Roig, 2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey/research article on the WLP conjecture for codimension-three Artinian Gorenstein algebras, indicating it remains an active open problem.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is still open as of 2025.

status_evidence.title: Lefschetz properties of some codimension three Artinian Gorenstein algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Studies special families to provide further evidence toward the conjecture without settling it.
